- Follow the existing project structure and coding style.
- Keep changes minimal, clean, and maintainable.
- Do not automatically replace relative paths (./, ../) with root-relative paths (/), or vice versa.
Use root-relative paths (/file) only when assets are served from the website root.
Use relative paths (./file, ../file) when assets are located relative to the current file or the application is deployed in a subdirectory.
Verify file locations, routing, and deployment base before suggesting path
- Ask for clarification if the project context is unclear.
